description.fallback: The Nine-Tails within Naruto helps beat Amachi. Although Amachi is quickly defeated and captured, the Umibōzu threatens to attack Naruto. Naruto summons Gamabunta and defeats it by evaporating its nucleus.

outro.fallback: Isaribi realises what Naruto said was right and that he did understand her because Naruto was also treated as a monster and with his help, Isaribi was happy.
